LESSON: WRITING 9.4.1 PUNCTUATION (THE COMMA)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.4: Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation (The comma)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation (The comma), part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: How do we use comma?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation (The comma) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
.Self-efficacy as learners individually use commas to write lists of items/ names.

Values:
Love: compassion as learners respects other’s opinions when working group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship: Social cohesion as learners take part in role play activities with peers.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The correct use of comma is related to pauses in Kenya Sign Language.

Suggested Learning Resources

Assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as Hearing aids and amplifiers, signed audio-visual recordings, print or digital stories, pocket
